model_contract.bounded_result_semantics: No witness means only that the explicitly enumerated finite cases were checked; it never proves the unbounded source statement.
model_contract.candidate_policy: Source-listed or otherwise encoded known examples are excluded from candidate output.
model_contract.counterexample_or_witness: the graph, weights, every spanning-forest base, S, H, cosets, preimage ranks, and both sides
model_contract.objects: graphic matroids of small labelled multigraph-free graphs with weights in composite cyclic groups Z_m
model_contract.premise: S, its stabilizer H, all quotient-coset preimages, and their graphic ranks violate the displayed inequality
model_contract.scope_limitation: The executor enumerates the explicitly named finite subfamily in model_contract.objects. A failure inside it is a valid source-level counterexample; no failure says nothing about objects outside it.
model_contract.source_statement:
Let $G$ be an (additive) abelian group, and for every $S \subseteq G$ let ${\mathit stab}(S) = \{ g \in G: g + S = S \}$.

Conjecture Let $M$ be a matroid on $E$, let $w: E \rightarrow G$ be a map, put $S = \{ \sum_{b \in B} w(b): B \mbox{ is a base} \}$ and $H = {\mathit stab}(S)$. Then $$|S| \ge |H| \left( 1 - rk(M) + \sum_{Q \in G/H} rk(w^{-1}(Q)) \right).$$
